Independently corroborated from PTC’s own side: a 2008 PTCPedia wiki carries live XUW articles.
affiliations.source: xuw-site.md

Roster raid traffic ran both directions (Kid Wonder moved from PCW to OSW), and PCW’s own champions challenged for OSW gold: at OSW’s 9 Feb 2003 Slam! broadcast, Politically Incorrect challenged for the OSW World Tag Team Championship and lost, with Heaven & Hell retaining. Off camera, the two were also sister companies under one real-world operator, alongside a wider family of promotions that included PTC, PURE, and others — the operator isn’t named here.
affiliations.source: osw-site.md

affiliations.note: OSW's own text calls itself "PCW's greatest rival" verbatim (K-Dub/Kid Wonder signing angle, Apr 2002). Ivan Stanislav's Red Army storyline is explicitly framed as a campaign against PCW owner Tyler Nelson ("I am here to educate the younger talent of OSW and lead my army into battle against Tyler Nelson!"); a Howard Porter promo frames OSW stepping "out of the shadows of PCW and their overbearing dictator." Recorded as a second, distinct edge alongside shared-continuity above because both are independently load-bearing in the source material, not two readings of the same fact.
affiliations.source: osw-site.md

Yoder will go there to ensure that NTICW’s operations are running well and up to PCW standards.” NTICW functioned as PCW’s direct developmental/overflow fed and closed under its own last owner.
affiliations.source: pcw-site.md

affiliations.source: pcw-site.md

affiliations.note: PCW’s own FAQ, verbatim: “It is a wrestling academy, which has been open since late 2000... We take the best workers from the PWA into PCW.” It is by far the most-cited outside promotion across PCW’s own wrestler bios — nearly every long-tenured PCW wrestler passed through it first. OSW’s own record independently confirms it as a shared academy feeding both OSW and PCW.
affiliations.source: pcw-site.md

affiliations.source: pcw-site.md

These are two related but not fully reconciled threads — an in-fiction invading stable named XEWF, and a real prior fed some handlers came from — presented here as found, without forcing them into one story.
